name: real_mask_audit.py
mathematical_scope: For an invertible normalized DFT, real and imaginary parts have complementary ranks. A real orthogonal simultaneous eigenbasis exhibits a diagonal mask with pure-real or pure-imaginary entries; any real-invertible sandwich with invertible diagonal Q has no mixed entries because the two ranks sum to n.
input_and_guard_coverage: No n-domain guards in this wrapper; numerical rank and phase categories use fixed 1e-9 thresholds, and zero diagonal values could be counted as both real and imaginary outside the intended invertible Fourier model.
costs: Dense eigendecomposition/matrix multiplications O(n³) time and O(n²) storage; the file explicitly disclaims a fast FFT.
test_evidence: Companion suite covers even n=4..128 and reconstruction residuals; no odd n, near-threshold ranks or malformed Fhat output.
acceptance_boundary: Accept the rank reasoning within real invertible mixer and Fourier assumptions, with eigenbasis as numerical positive control. It is not an algorithmic speedup.
findings: L13 relies on unpinned numeric_audit.Fhat; L15–25 are tolerance-based observations, not exact rank certificates.
